newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Peptide to postpone London listing.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Peptide to postpone London listing.

text.p: Drug development firm Peptide Technology Ltd said on Thursday it would postpone the secondary listing of its shares on the London Stock Exchange due to poor market conditions.

"The directors of Peptech have decided to postpone the application for a secondary listing on the London Stock Exchange due to unsatisfactory market conditions currently prevailing in London," Peptech said.
London's FTSE 100 share index closed on Wednesday up 25.2 points at 3,935.7, below its life record high set last week of 3,994.1.

A marketing exercise to potential investors linked to the listing process had led Peptech's directors to believe that "it was not in the best interests of the shareholders and the Company to proceed with the listing at this time."
"The directors continue to believe that Peptech has adequate cash resources to maintain its development momentum in key product areas," the company said.
Peptech's shares were down 17 cents at 65 cents at 11.40 am (0140 GMT).
